flow.zh:
亞德里亞海變奏曲
Adriatic Coast. Croatia

flow.caption_zh:
離開 Dubrovnik古城
Dalmatia沿海山路
蜿蜒險峻
一如它詭譎的歷史
晌午的風雨

zh: 那些流浪於奧狄塞史詩裡
en: One gust tighter than the last
Rapping urgently on the train window
Raising a vast haze of smoke and mist
Concealed the floating island and the cape
Farther still
The hazy Adriatic Sea
Those who wandered through the epic of the Odyssey
A sailor weary and longing for home
How can one resist
This expanse of wind, rain, and misty vapor
Returning to the harbor of their homeland?
Lodging for the night by the seashore
The sound of waves crashes against the shore
The crescent moon, cold

zh: 浸染著希臘和羅馬色澤
踐赴一場曾是輝煌的史蹟
en: Tomorrow, heading north
Crossing the ancient path of Diocletian
Villages, each stranger than the last
Place names, each older than the last
Steeped in the hues of Greece and Rome
In Split
Perhaps in Trogir
A castle facing the sea
The walls, ornate and splendid
The mural peels away
Guarding the North Gate
Perhaps it is the South Gate
Listening to the tide, waiting for the wind to turn
Craning the neck in hope
Drumbeats rise up from the sea
Venice's ships and merchant travelers
Breaking through the waves, it comes
Setting forth to a historic site once glorious

zh: 我們似乎也漂泊得很久
亞德里亞海的暮靄霞光
en: Like a sailor roaming the ends of the earth
Ships wander far across the four seas
On this ancient soil of a foreign land
It seems we too have drifted for a long time
Perhaps one should let
Thoughts drifting
Flowing light and shadow
Following the weary setting sun
Spiraling down together onto
The Adriatic's evening mist and glow
Also is
Where cloud and sail vanish from sight

points.zh: Dubrovnik ( 杜布鲁夫尼克城堡 )is a historical old city on the Adriatic coast ( 亞德里亞海沿岸 ) of Croatia, positioned at the southern terminal end of Croatia. It is one of the most famous tourist towns on the Adriatic Sea.  In 1979, the walled city of Dubrovnik joined the UNESCO list of the World Heritage Sites.
points.en: Dubrovnik (the walled old town of Dubrovnik) is a historical old city on the Adriatic coast (along the Adriatic Sea) of Croatia, positioned at the southern terminal end of Croatia. It is one of the most famous tourist towns on the Adriatic Sea. In 1979, the walled city of Dubrovnik joined the UNESCO list of World Heritage Sites.

points.zh: Dalmatia is an historical region of Croatia on the eastern coast of the Adriatic Sea.
points.en: Dalmatia is an historical region of Croatia on the eastern coast of the Adriatic Sea.

points.zh:
奧狄塞 (Odyssey)是希臘詩人荷馬所寫二大史詩之一，敘述因强奪海倫皇后，攻打特洛伊 (Troy)後，戰士們在還鄉途中，在海上漫長漂泊過程，所經歷的艱危困苦。愛倫坡 ( Edgar Allen Poe )所寫的「 致海倫，To  Helen 」一詩中的第一段：
「 海倫，你的美麗對於我／有如昔日尼西亞的帆船／在芬芳的海上悠然滑過／       載著疲困流浪的水手還鄉／回到他們故國的海灣。」
points.en:
The Odyssey is one of the two great epics written by the Greek poet Homer, describing the long and perilous wandering at sea endured by warriors on their way home after seizing Queen Helen and attacking Troy. The first stanza of "To Helen," a poem by Edgar Allan Poe:
"Helen, thy beauty is to me
Like those Nicean barks of yore,
That gently, o'er a perfumed sea,
The weary, way-worn wanderer bore
To his own native shore."

points.zh: Diocletian, a Roman Emperor from 284 to 305 AD, was born to a low status in the Roman province of Dalmatia (now Croatia). He decided in 286 to divide the Roman empire between himself in the east  ( 東羅馬 ) and Maximian in the west ( 西羅馬 )。
points.en: Diocletian, a Roman Emperor from 284 to 305 AD, was born to a low status in the Roman province of Dalmatia (now Croatia). He decided in 286 to divide the Roman empire between himself in the east (the Eastern Roman Empire) and Maximian in the west (the Western Roman Empire).

points.zh: Split and Trogir, two historic old towns on the Adriatic coast, are prominent tourist destinations in Croatia. Both are famed for their well-preserved palace and old city.
points.en: Split and Trogir, two historic old towns on the Adriatic coast, are prominent tourist destinations in Croatia. Both are famed for their well-preserved palace and old city.

points.zh: 威尼斯是威尼斯共和國 (13世纪到16 世紀 ) 的行政，貿易和文藝中心。鼎盛時期擁有船艦三千艘，來往於意大利，拜占庭和伊斯蘭諸國間，主宰亞德里亞海，愛琴海和地中海的海上貿易活動。
points.en: Venice was the administrative, trade, and cultural center of the Republic of Venice (13th to 16th centuries). At its height, it possessed three thousand ships, sailing among Italy, Byzantium, and the Islamic states, dominating maritime trade in the Adriatic Sea, the Aegean Sea, and the Mediterranean.
